bio.text: David Rouzer represents North Carolina's 7th Congressional District in the U.S. House.
He served two terms in the North Carolina Senate (2009-2012) representing Johnston and Wayne counties.

Earlier he was a senior staffer for Senators Jesse Helms and Elizabeth Dole, a presidential appointee at USDA Rural Development, and an assistant to the dean at NC State University's College of Agriculture & Life Sciences.
